name: lua_serial
description: Single-active UART library for ESP32 with Lua support. A script selects one port (hardware UART1/UART2, or port 3: an RMT-timed software UART on any free GPIOs) with runtime pin assignment, gets Arduino-Serial-like binary-safe read/write, and the port + pins are released on deinit or script exit. Built for bridging ESP-NOW traffic to serial.
keywords: lua, esp32, esp32s3, serial, uart, binary, bridge, espnow, rmt, softwareserial
